'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|So, how's your training going? I didn't think you still had so much to learn about warfare. That old saying ain't bullshit, ye? Luka and his squad could use a lesson. He said they got burned on the far side, had to retreat. Now the buggers at the base know they got competition, and they've tightened their defenses. They won't be able to take the base by surprise. That's why Luka asked to throw them some proper weapons to kill the cunts for sure. Everything they need is on the list right here. The cache must be real tough if those pricks aren't scared of even the military. Perhaps they got protection watching over them from the big land. But that protection ain't gonna reach us.}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only obtainable by [[USEC]] PMCs.

==Objectives==
* Hand over the item: 15 [[HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle]]
* Hand over the item: 4,500 [[5.56x45mm MK 318 Mod 0 (SOST)]]
* Hand over the item: 8 [[UVSR Taiga-1 survival machete]]

==Rewards==
* +1 [[Troubleshooting|Troubleshooting skill]] level
* +1 [[Mag Drills|Mag Drills skill]] level
* +1 [[Crafting|Crafting skill]] level
* +1 [[Endurance|Endurance skill]] level
* +1 [[Strength|Strength skill]] level
* +1 [[Metabolism|Metabolism skill]] level
* +1 [[Charisma|Charisma skill]] level
* +1 [[Intellect|Intellect skill]] level
{{quote|Even got the knives, impressive. I've already found a trusty bloke on the cordon who's gonna handle our deliveries. He's not asking for anything yet, but he'll surely put a premium on it later. It's a hell of a lot of work to get supplies to the mainland, you know.}}
